node.statement: The open challenge is mathematically correct: the exact allowed definitions and externals for this shard do not imply that the one-dimensional delta-projection Q is nonvanishing, so they do not furnish a universal c_u>0. Validated node 1.4.3.1 proves only the cancellation conditional on such a c_u. Accordingly, node 1.4.3 has been amended to remove the unconditional claim that C_as/c_u is finite and that root node 1 is proved. The valid conclusion is: if node 1.1 is eventually proved, then C_act=C_as/c_u is a finite universal constant and the asserted estimate follows; without node 1.1 no division by c_u and no unconditional root conclusion is licensed.
